description: Source code for managing cuBLAS and cuBLASLt handle pools, including handle creation, destruction, workspace management, and environment configuration, with support for CUDA and ROCm (HIP) backends.

classes.name: DeviceThreadHandlePool

classes.name: WorkspaceMapWithMutex
classes.description: Thread-safe map for associating handles and streams with workspace buffers.

methods.name: destroyCublasHandle
